Use the uploaded reference images as the only character references for Yuka and her female coworker. Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyles, identities, proportions, and clothing style of the referenced women. Do not redesign or replace them.

Create an ultra-realistic Japanese office building at night, with a haunted horror-movie tone. No background music. Use only realistic diegetic sound: fluorescent hum, distant air-conditioning, faint plumbing noise, soft footsteps, fabric rustle, zipper sounds, makeup clicks, and tense silence.

Scene: a clean but slightly cold office restroom with mirrors, white sink counters, pale tiles, and harsh fluorescent lighting. The atmosphere should feel ordinary at first, then subtly uncanny.

0s–5s
Yuka stands alone at the mirror fixing her makeup. Camera is behind her shoulder, showing the back of her head and her face reflected in the mirror. She carefully applies lipstick, then lightly pats foundation on her cheek with a makeup puff. Use a slow, steady push-in. Emphasize tiny realistic sounds: lipstick cap, puff tapping skin, quiet breathing.

5s–9s
As Yuka checks her face, a half-faded black human-shaped mist appears for only a brief moment in the mirror behind her, like a thin shadowy figure that is not fully solid, almost evaporating at the edges. Do not reveal it too clearly. Make it subtle, fast, and deeply unsettling. Add a faint wet whisper-like sound and a tiny distortion in the room tone.

9s–12s
Yuka notices something, freezes, and her eyes shift upward in fear. She slowly turns around. The camera pivots with her and now looks past her shoulder toward the empty restroom behind her.

12s–15s
There is nothing there. Empty stalls, cold fluorescent light, complete silence. Hold for a beat too long. Then Yuka breathes sharply, quickly stuffs her lipstick and makeup items into her pouch, and rushes out of the restroom. End on a fast uneasy movement toward the exit.

Style: ultra-realistic live action, Japanese horror film, subtle supernatural realism, restrained but terrifying, cinematic suspense, precise facial acting, realistic mirror reflections, oppressive silence, no gore, no comedy, no BGM.

Create an ultra-realistic Japanese office floor at night. Large open-plan office, many desks, office chairs, monitors, paperwork, glass partitions, dim ceiling lights, and only a few workers remaining. No background music. Use only diegetic sounds: door handle, footsteps, distant keyboard typing, printer hum, air-conditioning, chair movement, faint office ambience.

0s–3s
Yuka opens the office door and steps into the large dim floor. The camera follows slightly behind her. The office feels too quiet and too spacious. A few employees remain in the distance under cold lights.

3s–7s
A female coworker notices Yuka’s pale face and looks concerned. Medium shot, then slow push-in on the coworker. She says in natural Japanese only: 「どうしたの？ 顔が真っ青だよ？」 No English dialogue, no English subtitles. Keep natural Japanese lip sync and realistic office voice tone.

7s–10s
Yuka forces a small, uneasy smile and replies in natural Japanese only: 「ううん、なんでもないよ」 No English dialogue, no English subtitles. Her voice is strained and unconvincing. Camera stays close on Yuka’s face.

Over the coworker’s shoulder, slightly behind her, Yuka notices something wrong. For a single instant, the same black human-shaped mist appears diagonally behind the coworker, almost like a shadow standing where nobody should be. It resembles a vague human outline but made of black vapor.

Yuka blinks and it is gone. The coworker notices Yuka staring and tilts her head slightly, confused. Hold a beat of silence. End with Yuka disturbed but trying to act normal as she turns toward her desk.

Create an ultra-realistic Japanese office horror scene at night. Yuka sits at her desk in a mostly empty office. No background music. Use only diegetic sound: fast keyboard tapping, phone vibration, chair creak, breathing, fabric movement, distant office hum, the dry rattle of a dropped phone, and a low unnatural smoky hiss from the apparition.

0s–4s
Yuka sits down at her desk, opens her laptop, and mutters softly in natural Japanese only: 「早く終わらせて帰ろう」 No English dialogue or subtitles. She begins typing quickly, trying to focus. Close shots of fingers on keys, tense jaw, tired eyes, glowing screen light on her face.

4s–7s
Her smartphone suddenly vibrates loudly on the desk. Buzzing sound breaks the silence. Yuka glances over, annoyed and uneasy, taps the screen, notices a LINE notification marked with 1, and opens it.

7s–10s
On the phone screen is a completely black image. Yuka reacts: 「えっ？」 in natural Japanese only. No English dialogue. The black image begins to leak black mist out of the screen, as if thick dark dry-ice smoke is endlessly pouring from inside the phone. The mist spills over the phone edge, crawls downward, and spreads across the desk and toward the floor.

10s–12s
Yuka screams in natural Japanese only: 「きゃーっ！」 and drops the phone. It hits the floor. She falls backward hard and lands sitting on the floor in shock. The camera jolts with the movement.

12s–14s
The coworker rushes in from nearby and says in natural Japanese only: 「どうしたの？」 She reaches out to help Yuka up. Yuka, relieved for a split second, reaches her hand toward the coworker with a shaky smile.

14s–15s
Behind the coworker, the same black mist has formed a human-shaped double mimicking her pose exactly, like a shadow doppelganger reaching out in the same way. Reveal it for one horrifying instant. Yuka’s expression goes blank in pure terror and she loses consciousness. Cut abruptly to black.

Style: ultra-realistic live action, Japanese office horror, terrifying restraint, supernatural realism, strong jump in fear at the end, detailed smoke simulation, oppressive silence, no gore, no BGM.

Crea un edificio de oficinas japonés ultra-realista por la noche, con un tono de película de terror embrujada. Sin música de fondo. Usa solo sonido diegético realista: zumbido fluorescente, aire acondicionado distante, ruido tenue de tuberías, pasos suaves, crujido de tela, sonidos de cremalleras, clics de maquillaje y un silencio tenso.

Escena: un baño de oficina limpio pero ligeramente frío con espejos, encimeras de lavabo blancas, azulejos pálidos y una iluminación fluorescente intensa. La atmósfera debe sentirse ordinaria al principio, luego sutilmente inquietante.

0s–5s
Yuka está sola frente al espejo arreglándose el maquillaje. La cámara está detrás de su hombro, mostrando la parte posterior de su cabeza y su rostro reflejado en el espejo. Aplica cuidadosamente el lápiz labial, luego da ligeros toques de base en su mejilla con una esponja de maquillaje. Usa un acercamiento lento y constante. Enfatiza pequeños sonidos realistas: tapa del lápiz labial, esponja tocando la piel, respiración tranquila.

5s–9s
Mientras Yuka revisa su rostro, una niebla negra con forma humana medio desvanecida aparece solo por un breve momento en el espejo detrás de ella, como una figura sombría delgada que no está completamente sólida, casi evaporándose en los bordes. No la reveles demasiado claramente. Hazlo sutil, rápido y profundamente inquietante. Añade un leve sonido de susurro húmedo y una pequeña distorsión en el tono de la habitación.

9s–12s
Yuka nota algo, se congela, y sus ojos se mueven hacia arriba con miedo. Lentamente se da la vuelta. La cámara gira con ella y ahora mira más allá de su hombro hacia el baño vacío detrás de ella.

12s–15s
No hay nada allí. Cabinas vacías, luz fluorescente fría, completo silencio. Mantén un momento demasiado largo. Luego Yuka respira bruscamente, rápidamente guarda su lápiz labial y artículos de maquillaje en su bolsa, y sale corriendo del baño. Termina con un movimiento rápido e inquietante hacia la salida.

Estilo: acción en vivo ultra-realista, película de terror japonesa, realismo sobrenatural sutil, contenida pero aterradora, suspenso cinematográfico, actuación facial precisa, reflejos realistas en el espejo, silencio opresivo, sin gore, sin comedia, sin BGM.
